items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: the guy George Williams, drummer, he called me up in the morning to play every night with him.

ctx.x: And see, when I came out of the Navy, and the guy George Williams, drummer, he called me up in the morning to play every night with him. I said, well, how much is a job paying? And when he told me how much the job was paying, I said, yes, indeed. Because see, when I left away from him, we were getting a dollar and a half a night. Yeah. And on some of the jobs, like we played some of those big country clubs, we'd get three dollars a piece. So when I started working at Mary's Tavern, when I got out of the Navy in…
So that would be almost ten dollars.
